title: 2026 Season Power Rankings
subtitle: Pre-Week 6 board, post-waivers. Pocket takes over at No. 1, Hyper finally beat the Goats, the Eddies won three straight, and the Slumlords spent $30 on three $10 claims at the clear. Drummond is still looking for its first win.
method: W/L + win quality + roster ceiling + FAAB + pedigree + sit/start + trades; PF is evidence, not the ranking.

rankings.blurb: Juice: four straight wins and the league's best PF at 1443.5, about 160 clear of second place. Survived the Dongers 287–280 in Week 5 to sit at 4-1. CeeDee Lamb, Tetairoa McMillan and Trey McBride give the Host the deepest pass-catching group in WU country, and $101 is still the fattest wallet. Junk: a 1269.0 PA is fourth-worst, and Lamb (Q, quad) and Saquon (on IR) are both banged up. A trip to 2-3 Saltese should be a tune-up.

Juice: Jesse's LAB hung 299.5 on Morningside, the top score of Week 5, and won by 96.5 for a third straight W. Puka Nacua, Kyren Williams, Jeremiyah Love and two starting QBs (Jayden Daniels, C.J. Stroud) make for a loaded roster. Junk: 1250.0 PF is fourth, and the 1046.5 PA is the lowest in the league, so the schedule has helped. Rymo's SPD's come to town next, and that's a real test.

Juice: still 4-1 with 1241.0 PF and a 1076.5 PA, second-lowest in the league. Mahomes, Kittle, Derrick Henry and Bucky Irving give Heff as solid a core as anyone. Junk: the unbeaten run ended at Hyper 235–213, their first loss of the year. 213 was only the fourth-lowest score of Week 5, and the PF trails four teams. TTAB comes to town hot off a win, so the Goats need the 4-0 version back.

Juice: three straight wins after a 298-point beatdown of Doubtpfizer, Week 5's second-best score, by 66.5. The 1279.0 PF is third in the league, and Brock Bowers, Fred Warner and a Breece Hall/Rhamondre Stevenson backfield give it a real ceiling. Added Mansoor Delane for $8. Junk: 3-2 with a 1203.5 PA, and Hall and Jalen Coker are both questionable (quads). Substation is next, and it's on a two-game heater of its own.

Juice: Nate's crew went to SPD's and won 257–246.5 for two straight and a 3-2 record. Drake London, Malik Nabers and George Pickens is a WR trio that can win any week, and Brock Purdy is under center. Junk: 1136.0 PF is 11th, and the 1115.0 PA has done them some favors. The backfield is thin behind Emmett Johnson and RJ Harvey. Hosting the Eddies is the test of whether the streak is real.

Juice: TTAB beat Saltese 242–209 to get to 3-2, and the 1078.0 PA is third-lowest in the league. Josh Allen plus a backfield of Ashton Jeanty, Cameron Skattebo and Javonte Williams gives Chase plenty of ground game. Junk: 1153.5 PF is 10th, and the WR room (Christian Watson, Jameson Williams) is the weak spot. Next is a road trip to the Goats, who just took their first loss and won't be in a giving mood.

Juice: 1218.5 PF is sixth, and 246.5 was the fifth-best score of Week 5. Jonathan Taylor, Zay Flowers, Tee Higgins and Davante Adams are a strong core. Junk: it still lost, as Substation came in and took it 257–246.5, so the SPD's slide to 3-2 with a 1174.0 PA. A.J. Brown and TreVeyon Henderson are hurt. A trip to 4-1 LAB is next, and the SPD's need it to stay in the top tier.

Juice: Hyper finally got one, 235–213 over the Goats, handing them their first loss. The 1282.5 PF is second in the league, with Kenneth Walker III, Amon-Ra St. Brown and Justin Herbert leading the way. Junk: 2-3 with a 1317.5 PA, third-worst in the league, makes this the cruelest record in WU country. Kenyon Sadiq and Nick Bosa are both on IR. A trip to 1-4 Doubtpfizer is a game Hyper should win.

Juice: beat Ultron 243.5–207 to get to 2-3, and Jahmyr Gibbs, James Cook and Drake Maye are a strong core to build on. Then they spent $30 on three $10 claims. Junk: 1188.5 PF is eighth, and the 1352.0 PA is second-worst in the league. Quinshon Judkins (Q, foot) and Will Shipley (D, foot) are both banged up, and the wallet is down to $1. Next up is a road trip to Morningside.

Juice: 3-2 is a better record than most, and Justin Jefferson, Travis Kelce and Aaron Rodgers can still produce. Tim also dropped $30 on MarShawn Lloyd and Kimani Vidal. Junk: LAB hung 299.5 on them and won by 96.5, and 203 was the Week 5 floor. The 1044.0 PF is the lowest in the league, with Lamar Jackson on IR and Deebo Samuel out. The record is lying. Hosting the Slumlords is a must-win.

Juice: 1216.0 PF is seventh, and Christian McCaffrey, Nico Collins and Dak Prescott mean there's a real team here. Junk: the Eddies dropped 298 on them in a 231.5–298 loss, two straight losses, and the 1418.5 PA is the most in the league. Rashee Rice is on IR. At 1-4 the two-time champ is running out of runway, and hosting Hyper is about as must-win as October gets.

Juice: the 1184.5 PF is ninth, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Omarion Hampton and Matthew Stafford can all put up points. Junk: three straight losses after a 242–209 loss to TTAB, and 209 was the third-lowest score of Week 5. JSN, Stefon Diggs and DeVonta Smith are all questionable, and Micah Parsons is on IR. At 2-3 with a 1242.0 PA, a trip to 4-1 Pocket is the worst possible draw.

Juice: 280 points against Pocket, Week 5's fourth-best score, and a seven-point loss to the league's best team. Bijan Robinson, Joe Burrow and Chris Olave say this isn't a bad roster, and a 1124.0 PF backs that up. Junk: 0-5, five straight losses, and Tyreek Hill and D.J. Moore are both on IR. Ladd McConkey and T.J. Hockenson are questionable too. A trip to 1-4 Ultron is as good a chance as Drummond will get.

Juice: Ja'Marr Chase, Terry McLaurin and Bryce Young are the pieces of a team that should score more than this. Brian spent his last $10 and is now at $0. Junk: 207 was the second-lowest score of Week 5 in a 36.5-point loss to the Slumlords, and the 1053.5 PF is 13th. Three straight losses, with Kyle Monangai and Caleb Williams on IR and Myles Garrett hurt. Hosting winless Drummond is a must-win.
